  const labeledSearchs = document.querySelectorAll(".psp-search--labeled");

  labeledSearchs.forEach((labeledSearch) => {

  });
}

function removeLimitClassToSearchBar() {

function increaseFonts() {
  const wrapper = document.documentElement;

  if (wrapper.style.fontSize === "") {
    wrapper.style.fontSize = "110%";
    sessionStorage.setItem("font-size", "110%");

    addLimitClassToSearchBar();

    return;
  }

  const fontSizeWithoutPercentage = wrapper.style.fontSize.replace("%", "");

  const fontSizeNumber = Number(fontSizeWithoutPercentage);

  if (fontSizeNumber < 160) {
    const size = `${fontSizeNumber + 10}%`;
    wrapper.style.fontSize = size;
    sessionStorage.setItem("font-size", size);
    addLimitClassToSearchBar();
  }
}

function decreaseFonts() {
  const wrapper = document.documentElement;

  if (wrapper.style.fontSize === "") {
    wrapper.style.fontSize = "100%";
    sessionStorage.setItem("font-size", "100%");
    return;
  }

  const fontSizeWithoutPercentage = wrapper.style.fontSize.replace("%", "");

  const fontSizeNumber = Number(fontSizeWithoutPercentage);

  if (fontSizeNumber > 100) {
    const size = `${fontSizeNumber - 10}%`;
    wrapper.style.fontSize = size;
    sessionStorage.setItem("font-size", size);
  }

  if (fontSizeNumber <= 110) removeLimitClassToSearchBar();
}

function initializeFontSize() {
  const wrapper = document.documentElement;

  if (!size) {

      const shouldAddVisibility = !$list.classList.contains('visible');

    }

  const wrapper = document.documentElement;

  if (wrapper.style.fontSize === "") {

<script>
  (function() {
    const $wrapper = document.querySelector('.psp-footer');
    const $items = $wrapper.querySelectorAll('.collapsible');

    $items.forEach($item => {
      $item.addEventListener('click', () => {
        toggleListVisibility($item);
      })
    })

    function toggleListVisibility($item) {
      const $list = $item.parentElement.querySelector('ul');
      const shouldAddVisibility = !$list.classList.contains('visible');

      removeAllVisibility();

      if (shouldAddVisibility) $list.classList.add('visible');
    }

    function removeAllVisibility() {
      $items.forEach($item => {
        const $list = $item.parentElement.querySelector('ul');
        $list.classList.remove('visible');
      })
    }
  })();
</script>

}

function removeLimitClassToSearchBar() {

function increaseFonts() {
  const wrapper = document.documentElement;

  if (wrapper.style.fontSize === "") {
    wrapper.style.fontSize = "110%";
    sessionStorage.setItem("font-size", "110%");

    addLimitClassToSearchBar();

    return;
  }

  const fontSizeWithoutPercentage = wrapper.style.fontSize.replace("%", "");

  const fontSizeNumber = Number(fontSizeWithoutPercentage);

  if (fontSizeNumber < 160) {
    const size = `${fontSizeNumber + 10}%`;
    wrapper.style.fontSize = size;
    sessionStorage.setItem("font-size", size);
    addLimitClassToSearchBar();
  }
}

function decreaseFonts() {
  const wrapper = document.documentElement;

  if (wrapper.style.fontSize === "") {
    wrapper.style.fontSize = "100%";
    sessionStorage.setItem("font-size", "100%");
    return;
  }

  const fontSizeWithoutPercentage = wrapper.style.fontSize.replace("%", "");

  const fontSizeNumber = Number(fontSizeWithoutPercentage);

  if (fontSizeNumber > 100) {
    const size = `${fontSizeNumber - 10}%`;
    wrapper.style.fontSize = size;
    sessionStorage.setItem("font-size", size);
  }

  if (fontSizeNumber <= 110) removeLimitClassToSearchBar();
}

function initializeFontSize() {

    function highlightText(node, keywords) {
        if (node.nodeType === 3) { // Text Node

            keywords.forEach(keyword => {

  (function() {
    const $wrapper = document.querySelector('.psp-footer');
    const $items = $wrapper.querySelectorAll('.collapsible');

    $items.forEach($item => {
      $item.addEventListener('click', () => {
        toggleListVisibility($item);
      })
    })

    function toggleListVisibility($item) {
      const $list = $item.parentElement.querySelector('ul');
      const shouldAddVisibility = !$list.classList.contains('visible');

      removeAllVisibility();

      if (shouldAddVisibility) $list.classList.add('visible');
    }

    function removeAllVisibility() {
      $items.forEach($item => {
        const $list = $item.parentElement.querySelector('ul');
        $list.classList.remove('visible');
      })
    }
  })();

  const wrapper = document.documentElement;

  if (wrapper.style.fontSize === "") {
    wrapper.style.fontSize = "110%";
    sessionStorage.setItem("font-size", "110%");

    addLimitClassToSearchBar();

    wrapper.style.fontSize = size;

    addLimitClassToSearchBar();

  if (wrapper.style.fontSize === "") {

    wrapper.style.fontSize = size;
    sessionStorage.setItem("font-size", size);
